items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: But we played with Joe Rubischoff together.

ctx.x: I stayed down in Cuba six weeks with Joe Rubischoff. Well I stayed eight weeks in Canada with Paul. I stayed four weeks in Montreal with Lee Allen. I've been around.

Are there any other favorite trombone players that you've heard? Especially some of the old timers from here that you might, that you could tell something about their style and all too. Like you were talking about some of the other fellas.
